gaps: Terminal delivery events must ALWAYS append - even when the job's fingerprint moved on or the job is deleted; only the JOB projection (notified_fingerprint CAS + blocker action update) is conditional, with reread-classify on CAS miss

Exactly ONE terminal event per (promptId, generation) via card_delivery_terminal:<promptId>:<generation>; expiry uses card_delivery_expired:<promptId>; there is NO retrying event - attempt state reads from the outbound item

ambiguous/exhausted are DISPLAY-LEVEL ONLY: blocker, action, and setup_fingerprint never change while the prompt lives; an arrived card stays tappable; exhausted resume enqueues a NEW GENERATION on the SAME prompt

Expiry sweeps are OPEN-ONLY (claimed prompts never clobbered); expiry clears notified_fingerprint and a resume issues a NEW prompt row; the job-side expiry mutation is one dedicated coordination transaction
setup.deliveryNotice is presentation only - derived from the LATEST job.setup_card_delivery event for the current prompt/fingerprint via the S2a event read; never a second outbound notification
resolutions: Appendix S3 pins truthful-events-vs-conditional-projection; review brief carries per-contract verdicts
Idempotency keys are in the shared contract table; reconciler owns projection + job CAS + event append in one transaction
Fingerprint stability is load-bearing: approval validation requires prompt fingerprint == job fingerprint, so mutating the blocker would invalidate the very prompt the owner can still answer
Reconciler is a separate service on the existing shared 5s tick (recovery coordinator contract), not folded into the S3 repository
deliveryNotice rides Control API + contracts/SDK + CLI + shared scheduler formatter with one mapper; activation still gated by S3-RESULT
